title: Chilli Con Carne #2
preamble:
Serves 6
Ingredients:-
3
onions, diced
1
tbsp tomato puree, or 1/2 bottle of pasata
400g
packet chopped tomatoes
1
tbsp drinking chocolate
1kg
minced beef, extra lean
2
large carrots, diced
2
portobello mushrooms, sliced
2
sweet red peppers, chopped into large pieces
400g
tin kidney beans
1
tsp mild chilli powder
4
cloves garlic, peeled and chopped
1
splash ketchup
1
splash Worcestershire sauce
1
handful fresh herbs, eg: mint, basil, parsley. Chopped

Serves 6

400g
packet chopped tomatoes
1
tbsp drinking chocolate

large carrots, diced

portobello mushrooms, sliced

sweet red peppers, chopped into large pieces
400g
tin kidney beans
1
tsp mild chilli powder
4
cloves garlic, peeled and chopped
1
splash ketchup
1
splash Worcestershire sauce
1
handful fresh herbs, eg: mint, basil, parsley. Chopped

Method:-
Brown the mince in a heavy pan. Add all the other ingredients except the carrots and herbs.
Simmer for 1-2 hours (adding a little water if necessary).
Add carrots, peppers and herbs.
Simmer for further 30 minutes.
Serve your chilli con carne with rice or a baked potato.
